title: Jude and the Choir
author: Silas Joubert
blurb: Coral Dunmore, a beast-speaker hiding a forbidden gift, has never left the valley where magic cannot follow. But when tonight's date appears in a book of prophecies written a century ago, they discover that staying invisible was never really an option. Now they must find the door out of a country that no longer exists, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
